articles.summary: Honda Global | Repsol Honda HRC rider Toni Bou (Spain, 39 years old) claimed his record-extending 20th consecutive 2026 FIM Trial World Championship (TrialGP) title at the Netherlands GP, held from September 5–6.
articles.title: ＜FIM Trial World Championship＞ Toni Bou Wins 20th Consecutive Trial World Championship Title

articles.summary: Honda Global | Honda HRC PETRONAS rider Jeffrey Herlings (31, Netherlands) claimed the series championship in MXGP, the premier class, at Round 17 of the 2026 FIM Motocross World Championship (MXGP), the Türkiye GP, held from September 5–6.
articles.title: ＜FIM Motocross World Championship＞ Jeffrey Herlings Claims MXGP World Championship Title
